title: Missing test for ~0 JSON Pointer tilde escape (RFC 6901 §3)
description: parse.rs json_pointer_ext correctly implements '~0' → '~' per RFC 6901 §3 (replace '~1' first, then '~0', preventing double-substitution of '~01'). However there is no test for this case — only '~1' is tested in resolve_args_path_tilde_escaping. If someone rearranged or removed the ~0 branch a test would not catch it. Oracle: RFC 6901 §3 — {"a~0b": "tilde-value"} with path /a~0b must resolve to "tilde-value".
